summary: Scully Royalty Ltd. (NYSE: SRL) filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026 (period October 2026), attaching a September 29, 2026 press release disclosing that it is commencing legal action against former CEO Samuel Morrow, his Marshall Islands holding company Boardwalk Ltd., and beneficial shareholder Victoria Morrow. The claims seek, among other things, recovery of approximately CDN $2.1 million in allegedly wrongfully misappropriated funds. No settlement terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction pricing was included. This is a non-US issuer litigation/recovery update mapped to a US current report on Form 8-K; watch case progression and any recovery amounts.
